'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[2024 Lebanon pager explosions]]
***The death toll from yesterday's [[walkie-talkie]] explosions in [[Lebanon]] targeting [[Hezbollah]] militants increases to 25, with more than 600 others injured. A total of 37 people have been killed and more than 3,000 others injured in explosions over the last two days. [https://www.the-independent.com/news/world/middle-east/hezbollah-explosions-attack-lebanon-walkie-talkies-pagers-b2615018.html (''The Independent'')]
***[[United States]] [[Federal government of the United States|officials]] report that [[United States Secretary of Defense|Secretary of Defense]] [[Lloyd Austin]] was pre-warned by [[Israel]] about the military operation in Lebanon occurring later that day, and claim that they received no prior details about the nature of the attack. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-lebanon-pentagon-austin-gallant-4d893bb3fc1b23031c3bfc30e3650e0a (AP)]
**The [[Israeli Air Force]] strikes more than 100 Hezbollah targets in [[southern Lebanon|southern]] Lebanon, destroying [[multiple rocket launcher|multiple rocket launch systems]] and weapons depots. Lebanese security forces say the raids are the most intense since the conflict began. Israeli [[fighter aircraft|fighter jet]]s are also reported over [[Beirut]]. One Hezbollah militant is killed. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-strikes-hit-multiple-targets-lebanon-2024-09-19/ (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/9/20/israels-war-on-gaza-live-israeli-attacks-kill-dozens-in-gaza-west-bank-2?update=3190935 (Al Jazeera)]
**Two [[Israeli Ground Forces|Israeli soldiers]] are killed and eight others are injured in Hezbollah [[drone warfare|drone]] and [[anti-tank guided missile|anti-tank missile]] attacks on the [[Blue Line (withdrawal line)|Israel–Lebanon border]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-announces-two-soldiers-killed-in-hezbollah-attacks-on-northern-border/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli incursions in the West Bank during the Israel–Hamas war]]
***Six [[Palestinians]] are killed and 18 others are injured in an [[Israel]]i military raid in the city of [[Qabatiya]] in the [[West Bank]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/six-palestinians-killed-by-israeli-forces-occupied-west-banks-qabatiya-2024-09-19/ (Reuters)]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***The [[United Nations]] [[Committee on the Rights of the Child]] accuses Israel of severe violations of the [[Convention on the Rights of the Child]] through its military's actions in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-violated-global-child-rights-treaty-gaza-un-committee-says-2024-09-19/ (Reuters)]
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**[[Colombian peace process]]
***[[Colombia]] suspends [[peace process|peace negotiations]] with the [[National Liberation Army (Colombia)|National Liberation Army]] (ELN) [[insurgency|insurgent group]] after the ELN detonated explosives on a [[Military Forces of Colombia|military]] base, killing two soldiers and wounding more than two dozen others. [https://www.dw.com/en/colombia-suspends-peace-talks-with-eln-rebels/a-70263303 (DW)]
*[[2024 New Caledonia unrest]]
**Two [[New Caledonia]]n [[Secession|independence]] activists are killed by police during an operation in [[Saint-Louis, New Caledonia|Saint-Louis]] over their alleged involvement in the ongoing riots. [https://apnews.com/article/new-caledonia-france-unrest-indigenous-deaths-50c2911408e858e614376805c683aa63 (AP)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*A previously unknown piece composed by [[Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart]], ''[[Ganz kleine Nachtmusik]]'', is discovered at a library in [[Leipzig]], [[Germany]]. The seven miniature movements for a [[string trio]] were probably composed in the 1760s, when Mozart was in his early teens. [https://www.theguardian.com/music/2024/sep/19/previously-unknown-mozart-music-discovered-in-german-library (''The Guardian'')]

*[[2024 South American wildfires]]
**[[2024 Peru wildfires]]
***Out of control and deadly [[Wildfire|wildfires]] in [[Peru]] have reached at least seven [[List of archaeological sites in Peru|archaeological sites]] and have begun to burn near the [[Indigenous peoples of Peru|indigenous]] [[Shipibo-Conibo|Shipibo-Conibo community]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/fires-burn-out-control-peru-hitting-crops-archaeological-sites-2024-09-20/ (Reuters)]
*A military [[helicopter]] carrying international peacekeepers crashes near [[Mogadishu]], [[Somalia]]. The helicopter was en route to [[Baledogle Airfield]]. No fatalities are reported. [http://v.aa.com.tr/3335280 (Anadolu Agency)] [https://garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/helicopter-carrying-peacekeepers-crashes-in-southern-somalia (Garowe Online)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Venezuelan political crisis]]
**[[International reactions to the 2024 Venezuelan presidential election]]
***The [[European Parliament]] recognizes [[Venezuela]]n exiled presidential candidate [[Edmundo González]] as [[President of Venezuela|the country's president]]. [https://www.politico.eu/article/european-parliament-venezuela-exil-edmundo-gonzalez-legitimate-president/ (Politico.eu)]
*[[2000 Fijian coup d'état]]
**[[Fijians|Fijian]] coup leader [[George Speight]] is released from prison after obtaining a [[pardon]] from [[President of Fiji|President]] [[Wiliame Katonivere]]. Speight was imprisoned in 2002 for his role in the 2000 coup d'état in which ethnic Fijian nationalists attempted to overthrow [[Indo-Fijians|Indo-Fijian]] [[Prime Minister of Fiji|Prime Minister]] [[Mahendra Chaudhry]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/528473/fiji-coup-leader-george-speight-granted-presidential-pardon (RNZ)]
*[[Iranian interference in the 2024 United States elections]]
**The [[United States]] [[Federal Bureau of Investigation]] and two other American agencies announce that [[Iran]]ian [[Cyberwarfare by Iran|hackers]] sent unsolicited emails to people associated with the [[Joe Biden]] [[Joe Biden 2024 presidential campaign|presidential campaign]] that included material that was stolen from [[Donald Trump]]'s [[Donald Trump 2024 presidential campaign|campaign]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/politics-news/fbi-says-iranian-hackers-sent-stolen-trump-campaign-info-biden-campaig-rcna171759 (NBC News)]
